sloka: स्थितः तु प्राङ्मुखो भूत्वा शुचिर् मुनिवरः तदा ।ददौ रामाय सुप्रीतो मंत्र ग्रामम् अनुत्तमम् ॥१-२७-२२॥
transliteration: sthitaḥ tu prāṅmukho bhūtvā śucir munivaraḥ tadā ।dadau rāmāya suprīto maṁtra grāmam anuttamam ॥1-27-22॥

translations.english: The sage offered Rama the complete collection of those weapons which even the celestials find it difficult to acquire.
